import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive visualization
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
fig.suptitle('Sleep Health & Lifestyle Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# Color palette
palette = sns.color_palette("husl", 8)

# Plot 1: Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by BMI Category
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='Sleep Duration', y='Quality of Sleep', 
                hue='BMI Category', style='Gender', s=80, alpha=0.7, ax=ax1)
ax1.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality by BMI Category', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(title='BMI / Gender', bbox_to_anchor=(1.02, 1), loc='upper left', fontsize=8)

# Plot 2: Stress Level vs Physical Activity Level colored by Sleep Disorder
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
# Fill NaN in Sleep Disorder with 'None' for visualization
df_plot = df.copy()
df_plot['Sleep Disorder'] = df_plot['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None')
sns.scatterplot(data=df_plot, x='Physical Activity Level', y='Stress Level',
                hue='Sleep Disorder', s=80, alpha=0.7, ax=ax2, palette='Set2')
ax2.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level (min/day)', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_ylabel('Stress Level (1-10)', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_title('Physical Activity vs Stress Level by Sleep Disorder', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.legend(title='Sleep Disorder', fontsize=9)

# Plot 3: Average Sleep Quality by Occupation
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
occupation_sleep = df.groupby('Occupation')['Quality of Sleep'].mean().sort_values(ascending=True)
colors = sns.color_palette("viridis", len(occupation_sleep))
bars = ax3.barh(occupation_sleep.index, occupation_sleep.values, color=colors)
ax3.set_xlabel('Average Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_ylabel('Occupation', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_title('Average Sleep Quality by Occupation', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
# Add value labels on bars
for bar, val in zip(bars, occupation_sleep.values):
    ax3.text(val + 0.05, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2, f'{val:.1f}', 
             va='center', fontsize=9)

# Plot 4: Distribution of Sleep Duration by Age Group
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
# Create age groups
df_plot['Age Group'] = pd.cut(df_plot['Age'], bins=[25, 35, 45, 55, 65], 
                               labels=['26-35', '36-45', '46-55', '56-65'])
sns.boxplot(data=df_plot, x='Age Group', y='Sleep Duration', hue='Gender', 
            palette='Set1', ax=ax4)
ax4.set_xlabel('Age Group', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_ylabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_title('Sleep Duration Distribution by Age Group & Gender', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.legend(title='Gender', fontsize=9)

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
